text: @ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley 是适用于 DSH Web 客户端的文峰/文谷时段徽标插件。它把徽标注册到对话 composer dock，按北京时间显示当前处于高峰还是空闲时段，并提供下一次切换的方向与倒计时。工作日 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 为文峰，其余为文谷；时钟每分钟刷新。适合想在对话界面随时查看 DeepSeek 定价时段的用户。无需 API Key 或额外配置，时间由浏览器本地计算。

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley adds a badge to the DSH web conversation dock. It shows the current Beijing-time peak or off-peak period and a countdown to the next change. Weekday peak hours are 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00. It updates each minute from the browser clock; no API key is needed.
想在 DSH 对话页面随时看到 DeepSeek 当前是高峰还是空闲时段。
DSH 能不能显示距离下一个文峰或文谷时段还有多久？
I want to see the current DeepSeek peak or off-peak period in my DSH conversation.
@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley 的功能「文峰文谷徽标」：在对话 composer dock 显示当前北京时间对应的高峰或空闲状态、时刻及下次切换倒计时；组件每分钟按浏览器时钟更新。

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · @ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley：English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A tiny client-only plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: it pins a peak / off-peak badge
(`文峰` / `文谷`) next to the session stats line at the bottom of the conversation
(`1 轮 · 68 步 | LLM ...`), and keeps it in sync with Beijing time.

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · What it shows：| State | When (Beijing time) | Color |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **文峰** peak | Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 | red `#e5484d` |
| **文谷** valley | every other moment (nights, lunch break, weekends) | blue `#0091ff` |

Badge anatomy:

```text
文峰 14:26 · 距下谷 3小时34分
└─┬─┘ └─┬─┘   └───┬───┘ └──┬──┘
state  Beijing   next switch  time left
       clock     direction    (h/min)

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · What it shows：- `距下谷` (blue) — the schedule is about to drop into 文谷 at 12:00 / 18:00.
- `距下峰` (red) — the schedule is about to enter 文峰 at 09:00 / 14:00.
- Hovering the badge reveals the full window description and the exact Beijing timestamp.

The windows follow the footnote of the official pricing page:
<https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/>.

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · Install：Restart DSH afterwards; the badge appears in the composer dock next to the stats line.

To uninstall, drop the package from `dependencies` and from `dsh.profile.bundles`.

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · Behavior：- Registers into the `conversation.composer.dock` slot (`id: ds-peak-valley`, `order: 1`),
  so it sits on the same row as the session stats strip.
- Fully self-contained: Beijing time is derived from the **browser clock** with
  `Intl.DateTimeFormat` (`Asia/Shanghai`), then re-rendered once a minute.
- No configuration, no commands, no slash commands, no settings to toggle.

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · How it works：```text
lib/index.js    host entry — a no-op apply(); it exists so the package stays a
                loader entry that dsh-client-modules can scan for dsh.client
lib/client.js   browser bundle — the badge component and the schedule math
cordis.patch.yml  bundle patch — inserts the plugin row into the profile tree

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · How it works：- `computeStatus(date)` → `"peak" | "valley"`, from the weekday plus the minute of day.
- `nextTransition(date)` → `{ kind, minutes }`, the next 峰↔谷 boundary and how far away it is
  (weekends collapse into one long valley, so the next change is Monday 09:00).
- The timezone is hard-coded to `Asia/Shanghai` because the pricing schedule is defined in
  Beijing time; the machine's own timezone is irrelevant.
- The bundle registers with `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` and that `id` must equal the
  package name: the host composes the browser boot graph per package name, so a bundle that
  registers under any other id silently never mounts.

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · Privacy：The badge is computed entirely on the client: no HTTP requests, no telemetry, no API key,
no token consumption, and no repository or session data is read. Nothing leaves the page.

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · Development：```sh
node test/self-test.mjs   # or: npm test
```

The self-test loads `lib/client.js` against a stub `window.__ModuleLoader__` and a stub
`react`, then asserts:

- status boundaries (09:00 / 12:00 / 14:00 / 18:00, weekends),
- the next-transition countdown (including Fri 18:00 → Mon 09:00),
- the compact `h小时m分` countdown formatting,
- a render smoke test of the badge for both states.

CI runs the same suite on Node 18/20/22 (see `.github/workflows/test.yml`).

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · Compatibility：Written against the DSH client plugin API: the `conversation.composer.dock` slot,
the `react` seed module and `window.__ModuleLoader__` with `dsh.client.platform = "web"`.
Verified against DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 on both the desktop and the web profile. If a future DSH release renames the slot or the
loader entry point, only `lib/client.js` needs adjusting.

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · Troubleshooting：- **Badge missing** — check that the package name in `dependencies` matches
  `@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley` exactly, that it is listed in `dsh.profile.bundles`, and
  that the `link:` target still exists after moving the checkout.
- **Wrong state** — the plugin trusts the local clock. Make sure the system time is
  synchronized, then check the hover tooltip, which prints the computed Beijing timestamp.
- **Badge missing after renaming the package** — the bundle registers under the package name,
  so a rename must update `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml` and the `id` inside
  `lib/client.js` together; `npm test` fails until they agree.

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · License：MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

Unofficial community plugin; not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. If DeepSeek
changes its peak/off-peak windows, update `PEAK_WINDOWS` / `PEAK_WEEKDAYS` at the top of
`lib/client.js`.

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · 显示内容：| 状态 | 北京时间 | 颜色 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **文峰**（高峰） | 周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 | 红 `#e5484d` |
| **文谷**（空闲） | 其余所有时段（夜间、午休、周末） | 蓝 `#0091ff` |

徽标结构：

```text
文峰 14:26 · 距下谷 3小时34分
└─┬─┘ └─┬─┘   └───┬───┘ └──┬──┘
 状态  北京时间   切换方向   剩余时长
```

- `距下谷`（蓝字）：即将在 12:00 / 18:00 进入文谷。
- `距下峰`（红字）：即将在 09:00 / 14:00 进入文峰。
- 鼠标悬停可看到完整时段说明与当前北京时间的精确时刻。

时段规则与官方定价页脚注保持一致：
<https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/>。

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · 安装：前置条件：已安装 DSH（`web` 或 `desktop` profile 均可），Node.js ≥ 18。

克隆仓库后，把它作为树外 bundle 注册到目标 profile：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley.git

dsh plugin --profile web add link:<本地克隆路径>
```

也可以直接编辑 profile 清单（通常是 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json`）：

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley": "link:<本地克隆路径>"
  },

重启 DSH 后，徽标就会出现在对话底部的 composer dock 中，与统计行并排。

卸载：从 `dependencies` 和 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中同时移除该包即可。

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · 行为说明：- 注册到 `conversation.composer.dock` 槽位（`id: ds-peak-valley`，`order: 1`），
  因此与统计行同一行显示。
- 完全自包含：用浏览器**本地时钟** + `Intl.DateTimeFormat`（`Asia/Shanghai`）
  换算北京时间，每分钟刷新一次。
- 没有配置项、没有命令、没有开关。

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · 实现：```text
lib/index.js      宿主入口 —— 空的 apply()，仅用于让包保持为 loader entry，
                  dsh-client-modules 才能扫描到 dsh.client 声明
lib/client.js     浏览器 bundle —— 徽标组件与时段计算
cordis.patch.yml  bundle patch —— 把插件行插入 profile 的插件树

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · 实现：- `computeStatus(date)` → `"peak" | "valley"`，由「星期几 + 当天分钟数」判定。
- `nextTransition(date)` → `{ kind, minutes }`，下一次 峰↔谷 边界及剩余分钟数
  （周末是连续文谷，故下一次切换是周一 09:00）。
- 时区硬编码为 `Asia/Shanghai`：定价时段以北京时间为准，与机器本地时区无关。
- 浏览器 bundle 以 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` 注册，`id` 必须与 `package.json` 的包名
  完全一致：宿主按包名组装 boot graph，id 不一致时这一行永远不会被满足（徽标静默不出现）。

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · 隐私：徽标全部在客户端本地计算：不发起任何 HTTP 请求、不上报遥测、不需要 API Key、
不消耗 token，也不读取会话或仓库内容。任何数据都不会离开页面。

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · 开发：```sh
node test/self-test.mjs   # 或 npm test
```

自测会用假的 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 与假的 `react` 加载 `lib/client.js`，覆盖：

- 状态边界（09:00 / 12:00 / 14:00 / 18:00、周末）；
- 下一次切换的倒计时（含周五 18:00 → 周一 09:00）；
- `h小时m分` 倒计时格式化；
- 两种状态下徽标的渲染冒烟测试。

CI 在 Node 18/20/22 上跑同一套测试（见 `.github/workflows/test.yml`）。

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · 兼容性：面向 DSH 客户端插件 API 编写：`conversation.composer.dock` 槽位、`react` seed 模块、
以及 `dsh.client.platform = "web"` 下的 `window.__ModuleLoader__`。
已在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 的桌面版与 Web profile 上验证。如果未来 DSH 改动槽位名或 loader 入口，
只需调整 `lib/client.js`。

@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley README · 常见问题：- **看不到徽标** —— 检查 `dependencies` 里的包名是否与 `@ttxl314/dsh-ds-peak-valley`
  完全一致、是否已加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`，以及克隆目录移动后 `link:` 路径是否失效。
- **状态不对** —— 插件信任本地时钟。请先同步系统时间，再看悬停提示里打印的北京时间。
- **改包名后徽标消失** —— bundle 以包名注册，重命名时必须同时改 `package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml` 和 `lib/client.js` 里的 `id`；三者不一致时 `npm test` 会直接失败。
